Identified as this saint because: Commons records it as a Cretan-school icon, tempera and gold on wood, made in Crete between 1668 and 1800, of the Ten Martyrs of Crete, now in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de la Ville de Paris. Gelasius is one of those ten, kept with them on 23 December, this folder's Greek feast; he is shown among them, not alone.
